text.en:
MALACAÑANG
PRESIDENTIAL DECREE No. 427 April 1, 1974
AMENDING PRESIDENTIAL DECREE NO. 337 BY INCLUDING CIVILIAN PERSONNEL OF THE
NATIONAL INTELLIGENCE AND SECURITY AUTHORITY AND THE CIVIL INTELLIGENCE AND
SECURITY AGENCY AMONG THOSE WHO SHALL BE GRANTED LONGEVITY PAY
WHEREAS, Presidential Decree No. 337 grants longevity pay to civilian investigation agents of the Criminal
Investigation Service, Philippine Constabulary, and to civilian intelligence agents of the intelligence
services/units of the Armed Forces of the Philippines;
WHEREAS, the civilian intelligence personnel of the National Intelligence and Security Authority and the
Civil Intelligence and Security Agency have also participated and played an important role in the suppression
of criminality and other forms of lawlessness related to subversion, insurrection and rebellion and in the
identification, detection, and arrest of leaders and hard core members of the communist
organizations/movements;
WHEREAS, the civilian intelligence personnel of the National Intelligence and Security Authority and the
Civil Intelligence and Security Agency are exposed to the same dangers as their counterparts in the Armed
Forces of the Philippines in the performance of hazardous mission;
WHEREAS, it is also imperative to raise the efficiency and morale of the civilian intelligence personnel of the
National Intelligence and Security Authority and Civil Intelligence and Security Agency in consonance with
the policy of the government to inculcate professionalism in the service;
NOW, THEREFORE, I, FERDINAND E. MARCOS, President of the Philippines, by virtue of the powers
vested in me by the Constitution as Commander-in-Chief of all the Armed Forces of the Philippines, and
pursuant to Proclamation No. 1081, dated September 21, 1972, and General Orders No. 1, dated September
22, 1972, do hereby order and decree that henceforth:
1. Civilian intelligence personnel of the National Intelligence and Security Authority and Civil Intelligence
and Security Agency, whose powers and duties are defined in Presidential Decree No. 51 and Letters of
Implementation Nos. 52A, 52B and 52C shall receive, in addition to their basic monthly salary, longevity pay
equivalent to ten per centum of their latest salary for every five years of continuous service with government
intelligence services and agencies, including the defunct National Intelligence Coordinating Agency:
Provided, That the longevity pay as computed shall not exceed fifty per centum of their basic salary.
2. Such sums as may be necessary to implement this Decree is hereby appropriated out of the savings of the
National Intelligence and Security Authority and Civil Intelligence and Security Agency, as the case may be.
Thereafter, the sum necessary for the purpose shall be included in the General Appropriations Act.
This Decree shall take effect immediately.
Done in the City of Manila, this first day of April in the Year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and seventy-four.
